evidence: [B+C] proxy implementation in the DP4 simulator, not vLLM

provenance.base: DP4/sim/ copied once into the scratchpad (git 2524bb2; DP4/sim working tree dirty: another agent was editing qa_eval.py, merge_systems.py and adding sensitivity.py; arms.py and simulator.py are unmodified vs HEAD). Only dp1_bridge.py was changed in the copy (absolute path to the read-only DP1 physics) so that tests run from the scratchpad; the 52 tests of test_sim.py pass on the pristine copy. Each scenario is an ordered edit list (harness H, shared S, C1, C2) applied to this base; per-hunk diff -u was run on each edit.
provenance.loc_rule: added (+) lines that are neither blank nor comment-only in `diff -u`; a modified line counts once (as its + line). Deleted lines are recorded as loc_deleted and not added.
provenance.module_size_rule: module_size_loc = current AST line span (end_lineno - lineno + 1) of the pristine class/method nodes listed in component_size_basis for that component; where one method holds several components (C2DistLock._submit, C1Central.__init__/_submit) the component is a judgement and sizes of two components can overlap
provenance.shared_rule: a component is shared if both candidates must change it (shared-stage hunk, or the same component touched by both candidates). A hunk replicated into two different components (S3 ScorePolicy class) is counted in each candidate's own component, not shared.
provenance.harness_rule: not counted: workload/trace generation, request record fields used only as carriers, hardware parameters in the config, pool device topology, metrics, and for S3 the reference pool population + existing LRU (the 'existing implementation' that the scenario swaps out, absent from the pristine simulator).
provenance.smoke_helpers: scratchpad/qa4/{qa4build,run_build,assemble}.py, s{1..4}_edits.py (edit lists), smoke/s{1..4}_smoke.py, smoke/regress.py, smoke/cmp.py, verify.sh (not part of the repo)

sensitivity_alternatives.S1_C2_grant_protocol_change_is_major: If replacing the lock-manager grant protocol by CAS acquire is regarded as a protocol meaning change (nodes cannot mix modes), the pre-registration rule gives M1 = one star for that change. Modelled in qa4_modifiability.json as an analytic alternative.
sensitivity_alternatives.S1_coherent_region_model_as_shared_modul: The CoherentRegion hardware model (CAS latency, 64 KiB capacity) is counted as harness. If it were counted as a shared change of the Publish/Visibility protocol (flush/invalidate rules), both candidates get +1 module and +4 LOC (config 2, Params 2).
sensitivity_alternatives.S3_C2_entry_layout: A real frequency x reconstruction-cost score needs two more per-entry fields. In C1 they live in the server index (no extra module). In C2 the cacheline-packed shared entry (Shared metadata layout) must grow and lock-free lookups would have to write the frequency (or an approximate counter): +1 module for C2 (analytic, not measured; the simulator keeps freq/cost in the harness pool population).
sensitivity_alternatives.S4_C2_per_shard_objects: C2's S4 hunks are large (16 LOC) because the proxy keeps lock arrays monolithic. Refactoring C2DistLock into per-pool shard objects would shrink the diff, but is a refactor beyond the minimal change; not measured.
